plain: A vassal's sworn loyalty to his lord.

webster.text: Fidelity to a lord; faithful adherence of a tenant or vassal to the superior of whom he holds his lands; loyalty.

example.quote: and a number of subordinate vassals, or feudatories, who had large portions of land allotted to them, and numerous trains of INFERIOR vassals or retainers, who occupied and cultivated that land upon the tenure of fealty or obedience, to the persons of whom they held it.
